title: Whereas, even though, nevertheless
summary: Nối ý tương phản: whereas/while (so sánh hai bên), even though (dù), nevertheless/nonetheless (tuy vậy), in spite of the fact that.

dialogue.en: Do you and your sister look alike?
dialogue.vi: Bạn với chị gái có giống nhau không?

dialogue.en: Not really. She's tall, [[whereas]] I'm quite short.
dialogue.vi: Không lắm. Chị ấy cao, còn mình khá thấp.
Hai chị em có hợp nhau không?
Có, dù đôi khi cãi nhau.

dialogue.en: She lives far away now, right?
dialogue.vi: Giờ chị ấy sống xa phải không?
Ừ. Tuy vậy, ngày nào bọn mình cũng nói chuyện.

sections.heading: Whereas, while
sections.rule: **whereas / while** nối hai mệnh đề **trái ngược nhau** khi so sánh hai người, hai vật. Thường có dấu phẩy.

examples.en: My brother loves football, [[whereas]] I prefer tennis.
examples.vi: Anh tôi thích bóng đá, còn tôi thích quần vợt hơn.

examples.en: [[While]] the city is noisy, the village is calm.
examples.vi: Thành phố ồn ào, trong khi làng quê yên tĩnh.

check.prompt: Hanoi has four seasons, ___ Saigon is hot all year.

sections.heading: Even though, in spite of the fact that
sections.rule: **even though** = dù (mạnh hơn although) + mệnh đề. **in spite of / despite + the fact that + mệnh đề**.

examples.en: [[Even though]] it was raining, we went out.
examples.vi: Dù trời mưa chúng tôi vẫn ra ngoài.

examples.en: [[Despite the fact that]] he was ill, he came to work.
examples.vi: Mặc dù bị ốm anh ấy vẫn đi làm.
examples.why: Despite the fact that + mệnh đề.

check.prompt: In spite of the fact ___ she was tired, she kept working.
check.explain: In spite of the fact that + mệnh đề.

sections.heading: Nevertheless, nonetheless, even so
sections.rule: **nevertheless / nonetheless / even so** = tuy vậy. Đứng **đầu câu mới**, sau dấu chấm hoặc chấm phẩy, có dấu phẩy theo sau. Trang trọng hơn however.

examples.en: The task was hard. [[Nevertheless]], we finished on time.
examples.vi: Việc khó. Tuy vậy, chúng tôi vẫn xong đúng hạn.
examples.why: Đầu câu mới, sau đó dấu phẩy.

examples.en: It was expensive; [[even so]], it was worth it.
examples.vi: Nó đắt; dù vậy vẫn đáng tiền.

check.prompt: The hotel was old. ___, it was very clean.
check.explain: Câu mới, ý trái ngược → Nevertheless.

mistakes.wrong: Even though the rain, we went out.
mistakes.right: Even though it was raining, we went out.

mistakes.wrong: Despite he was ill, he came.
It was cold, nevertheless we swam.
mistakes.right: It was cold. Nevertheless, we swam.

mistakes.wrong: She likes tea, whereas likes coffee he.
mistakes.right: She likes tea, whereas he likes coffee.
mistakes.why: Mệnh đề sau whereas giữ trật tự S + V.

mistakes.wrong: In spite of the fact he was late, he got the job.
mistakes.right: In spite of the fact that he was late, he got the job.

exercises.prompt: I like the beach, ___ my wife prefers the mountains.
___ he had no experience, he got the job.
The film was long. ___, I enjoyed it.
___ the fact that it was late, the shop was busy.

options: Even though tired, she kept going.
Even though she was tired, she kept going.
exercises.explain: Even though + mệnh đề đầy đủ.

exercises.prompt: My sister is shy, ___ I am very talkative.
answers: whereas
while

exercises.prompt: ___ though the food was cheap, it was delicious.
answers: Even

exercises.prompt: The road was icy. ___, he drove fast.
answers: Nevertheless
Nonetheless
Even so

exercises.prompt: In spite of the fact ___ it was Sunday, she worked.
answers: that
exercises.explain: In spite of the fact that.

exercises.vi: Dù mệt cô ấy vẫn làm tiếp.
Anh tôi cao còn tôi thấp.

exercises.sentence: Even though the traffic, we arrived on time.
answers: Even though the traffic was bad, we arrived on time.

exercises.sentence: In spite the rain, we went out.
answers: In spite of the rain, we went out.

exercises.sentence: Despite he studied hard, he failed.
answers: Although he studied hard, he failed.

exercises.vi: Dù đắt, tôi vẫn mua nó.
answers: Even though it was expensive, I bought it.
Even though it was expensive, I still bought it.
Although it was expensive, I bought it.
Although it was expensive, I still bought it.
Despite the price, I bought it.
Even though it was expensive, I bought it anyway.

exercises.vi: Tôi thích trà, còn chồng tôi thích cà phê.
answers: I like tea, whereas my husband likes coffee.
I like tea, while my husband likes coffee.
I like tea whereas my husband likes coffee.
I prefer tea, whereas my husband prefers coffee.
I like tea, but my husband likes coffee.
